label: Schopenhauer identified Kant unknown Noumenon as the blind striving metaphysical Will
description: Arthur Schopenhauer took up the concept of "Phenomena vs. Noumena (Thing-in-Itself)" and systematized its implications for later thought.
dialecticalTension: Dialectical engagement with the core claims and paradoxes of "Phenomena vs. Noumena (Thing-in-Itself)".
historicalContext: Inherited and re-evaluated during the 19th Century Divergences.
